about.description: STRC is a single-stock perpetual on trade[XYZ] tracking Strategy Inc. Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock. Strategy Inc. Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock is a preferred security paying variable-rate dividends, issued by the company formerly known as MicroStrategy (Nasdaq: STRC). The market is cash-settled with hourly funding, no shareholder rights, and no dividend rights in the underlying.
